{{Quote|Our time has come. For 300 years, we prepared. We grew stronger. While you rested in your cradle of power, believing your people were ''safe''... and ''protected''. You were trusted to ''lead'' the Republic—but you were deceived, as our powers over the dark side have blinded you. You assumed no force could challenge you...and now...''finally''...we have returned.|[[Darth Malgus]] during the invasion of the Jedi Temple|audio=InvasionOfTheJediTemple.flac|<ref name="Deceived">{{TORweb|url=info/media/trailers/deceived-cinematic-trailer|text=Deceived Cinematic Trailer|int=Deceived}}</ref>}}
The following events took place in '''3653 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
{{Quote|Thus began the unprecedented stalemate. The Jedi reconnecting with their roots, the Republic nursing its wounds, the Sith consolidating their power in a galaxy divided between darkness and light.|[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Gnost-Dural]]|audio=ColdWarStalemate.flac|<ref name="Timeline 1">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 1: Treaty of Coruscant|int=Timeline 1: Treaty of Coruscant}}</ref>}}
*Republic and Imperial delegates meet for an [[Alderaan peace conference|peace conference]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].
*A [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] strike team under the command of [[Darth Malgus]] and Lord [[Adraas]] attack and destroy the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]], disabling [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] defense grid.
*The [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Angral]] leads an Imperial armada in attacking and conquering Republic capital in what would become known as the [[Sacking of Coruscant]].
*Faced with an Imperial occupation of the capital, the Republic delegation is forced to sign the [[Treaty of Coruscant]] and end the [[Great Galactic War]], retreating from many battlefields and ceding the Empire important systems.
*The [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] begins as the two galactic powers begin to rebuild.
*A flock of [[xuvva]]s latch onto a subterranean power conduit near the city of [[Jiguuna]] on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]], and the creatures sap enough power to black out half of Jiguuna.<ref name="Xuvva Codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Xuvva}}</ref>
